How They Handle Restricted Countries

Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and PayPal have all been known to restrict or suspend accounts in certain countries, including Nigeria, Ghana, and Pakistan. This leaves creators with no other choice but to seek alternative payment gateways, which can be time-consuming and unreliable. NOWPayments, on the other hand, offers a seamless onboarding process, with no KYC requirements and no need for buyer accounts. This means that creators can sell presets to customers worldwide, without worrying about account restrictions or suspensions.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

When it comes to payment speed, NOWPayments stands out from the competition. With automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, payments are processed in real-time, ensuring that creators receive their funds instantly. And with a fee of only 0.5%, creators can keep more of their hard-earned profits. In contrast, Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy charge significantly higher fees, while PayPal's fees can add up quickly, especially for high-volume sales. When selling presets, every penny counts, and NOWPayments offers a more cost-effective solution.

Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

With NOWPayments, creators can automate their delivery process, ensuring that customers receive their presets instantly, without any hassle. And with full ownership of their digital products, creators can rest assured that their intellectual property is protected.
